conclusion: In the end, the evidence on each measure reads like this. Overall, Brostamide and Standard care reach about the same blood pressure control.
section:
### Comparison of the arms

Standard care is the usual blood pressure treatment given to every patient. Brostamide is a water tablet that helps the body clear extra salt. The groups in this comparison were followed at the Harbor Street Patients.

Table 4. Counts and means for every group, measure and subset.

| Subset | Arm | Measure | Count | Total |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Older adults, Normal kidney function, Community clinic | Standard care | Blood pressure control | 312 | 550 |
| Older adults, Normal kidney function, Community clinic | Brostamide | Blood pressure control | 335 | 550 |
| Older adults, Reduced kidney function, Community clinic | Standard care | Blood pressure control | 320 | 550 |
| Older adults, Reduced kidney function, Community clinic | Brostamide | Blood pressure control | 307 | 550 |

These values are listed for every arm and every subset.
